text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a single canonical surface for routing status that SDKs/console/telemetry all use. Right now the console shows mixed badges (degraded vs fallback) which confuses customers.
Sam: Do we want a machine-level code + human label? eg. {route_code: ROUTE_FALLBACK, label: 'Fallback'} :+1:
Kevin: Strong yes on a machine code. UX prefers softer phrasing for users. 'Fallback' can sound like total failure.
Olivia: Proposal: two-tier display — short badge (e.g., 'Reduced fidelity') and a tooltip/row with the reason (quota, region outage, model swap). We should A/B test copy.
Sam: Telemetry needs a fixed enum so dashboards can filter: route_reason = [quota_limit, capacity_pressure, region_failover, model_degrade, manual_override].
Maya: For HTTP surface, we should avoid inventing new status codes. I'm leaning: 429 for quota, 503 for capacity/outage, and 200 for a successful response that used a lower-tier route but includes diagnostics.
Kevin: Agreed. Keep non-breaking for clients: return 200 when we can satisfy the request albeit degraded, then include diagnostic fields: "route_code", "route_severity" ('degraded'|'normal'), and "route_reason".
Olivia: Console UX: show primary badge from route_severity and secondary line with a friendly reason. Example copy options: A) 'Reduced quality (using a smaller model)' B) 'Service routed to lower-capacity endpoint'. I'll mock both.
Sam: SDKs should expose helpers: RouteInfo.from_response(resp) -> {is_degraded, user_message}. We'll add language mappings.
Maya: Telemetry note: ensure traces include route_code and route_reason as indexed tags. That will let product queries like "show all requests with route_reason=quota_limit in last 24h".
ProductBot: FYI — support playbook needs updated text for billing/quotas when showing degraded requests. I'll file a tickets.
Kevin: One more: error vs informational split. If a call truly failed (no output), continue using 5xx/4xx. If we returned degraded content, 200 + route diagnostics.
Maya: Sounds like consensus. Action items: Sam -> SDK spec + changelog; Kevin -> API schema + integration tests; Olivia -> copy variants + console mock; Maya -> telemetry enum + dashboard filters.
Sam: I'll open the API PR with example responses and mapping table.
Kevin: I'll add the route_code enum to the openapi schema and wire up tests for the console contract.
Olivia: I'll push two copy mocks to the console repo and set up a small canary in rollout.
infra-bot: Deploy plan: new contract will be rolled out to 10% canary group on 2024-03-24T09:00:00Z, then 100% after 72h if no regressions.
Maya: Quick callout — make sure billing pages indicate that degraded responses may have different cost profiles. Sam, add a sample response field for cost_estimate.
Sam: Will do, adding "estimated_tokens_used" and "route_code" to examples.
Olivia: I'll prepare the A/B test and link results in the PR.
Maya: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open until canary completes. Ping here with PR links. :thumbsup:
